description: Sends one WhatsApp message into one conversation that already exists, named by conversation_id. It reaches a real person on their phone and cannot be unsent. It sends only on a confirmed call: without confirmation_token it sends nothing and returns a preview and a token for a person to approve; called again with that token, it sends. Changing a single character between the two calls invalidates the token. A chat nobody holds, or one this person holds, is sent to as usual, and sending does not lock it. A chat another person holds in the Cosend Inbox stays theirs: the preview and the send both return conversation_locked, naming who holds it. To send there, ask them for the chat; it passes over when they say yes or do not answer within 60 seconds. A chat changes hands only when its holder is asked. There is no bulk send: no recipient list, no send-to-tag, no send-to-all, and no way to start a conversation with a new number; this tool takes no phone number at all. Reaching many people is a saved, human-approved audience in the Cosend dashboard, not this tool. Limits per workspace: 20 a minute, 200 a day, and one per conversation every 30 seconds. The 24-hour customer service window opens when the customer writes and starts again with each message from them; outside it, anything but an approved template is refused. A send needs no opt-in. Only an opt-out on this number stops it: a STOP, WhatsApp’s own opt-out or an owner’s entry. A STOP to one number stops sends on that number only, and the business’s other numbers keep sending.

audio.description: Meta's media object. `id` may be a Cosend media id (`med_…`, from `POST /v1/media`): Cosend uploads the file to WhatsApp and sends it by WhatsApp's id, and the message's `media` block then names the file. With a Cosend id, `caption` is allowed on image, video and document (not on audio or sticker), and `filename` on document only (it defaults to the uploaded name). Meta's own `id` or `link` goes to WhatsApp unchanged.

confirmation_token.description: For a call that needs approval: left out, the call does nothing and returns a preview and a token; given that token, with the same arguments, the call does it.

interactive.description: Meta's interactive object. Checked against WhatsApp's limits before anything is written, and refused in words naming the field: a reply-button message (type "button", up to 3 buttons), a list message (type "list"), a catalogue message (type "catalog_message": body up to 1024 characters, footer up to 60, optional action.parameters.thumbnail_product_retailer_id), a single-product message (type "product": action.product_retailer_id, optional body and footer, no header) and a multi-product message (type "product_list": a text header up to 60 characters, a body, action.sections of product_items, at most 10 sections and 30 products, a title up to 24 characters on each section when there is more than one). A product message may leave out action.catalog_id, and Cosend sends the catalogue linked to the number's WhatsApp Business account in Meta's Commerce Manager; a catalogue message, and a product message without catalog_id, are refused in words when the number has none linked. A catalog_id you give is sent as given. Like every free-form message, they go only inside the 24-hour customer service window. Any other interactive type goes to WhatsApp unchanged.

source.description: Who is sending. Left out, it is agent for a person (the dashboard Inbox, or an MCP client acting for one) and api for an API key.

template.description: Meta's template object: {"name", "language": {"code"}, "components"}. A header parameter of type image, video or document may name a file uploaded with POST /v1/media by its id ({"type": "image", "image": {"id": "med_…"}}): Cosend uploads it to Meta for this number and sends Meta's id; a link, or a media id from Meta, is sent as it is. A location parameter ({"type": "location", "location": {"latitude", "longitude", "name", "address"}}) needs a latitude from -90 to 90 and a longitude from -180 to 180, in decimal degrees; name and address are text.
